## 보관 원문

> # AIST 2026 — Recent HIsarna operational developments at the IJmuiden pilot plant
>
> Tata Steel authors presented updated HIsarna pilot-plant results at AIST's
> Scrap Supplements and Alternative Ironmaking 10 conference, held in Orlando
> on 9–11 March 2026.
>
> The presentation reports cumulative production of 18,450 tonnes of hot metal,
> of which 17,450 tonnes was supplied to the BOF plant. The longest continuous
> run was 19.5 days; availability during long runs was 93%. Highest productivity
> was 7.5 tHM/h and best daily production was 160 tHM/d. These are pilot campaign
> records, not annual commercial availability or nameplate performance.
>
> At 7.5 tHM/h, a coal rate of 726 kg/tHM was demonstrated. The feedstock
> campaigns covered coal with 3–39% volatile matter, 0.37–1.55% sulfur, 5–14%
> ash and 58–85% fixed carbon. A low-grade-ore campaign processed 750 tonnes of
> ore with Fe below 60% and Al2O3 above 5%. Slag Al2O3 approached 25% while
> stable operation was maintained.
>
> For fossil-carbon substitution, the slides distinguish past achievements from
> targets. They report 45% coal replacement by biochar in earlier work and more
> than 15% coal replacement by natural gas at low production rates during the
> first commissioning test. The stated 100% biochar use is an aim, not an
> achieved result.
>
> For circularity, the pilot processed 800 tonnes of BOF slag and 100 tonnes of
> EAF slag. The presentation reports successful use of BOF slag as a standard
> flux and successful testing of HIsarna slag in cement and concrete.
>
> Recent upgrades included a higher-capacity gas cooler, SCR DeNOx, a natural-gas
> injection lance and an infrared camera inside the reactor. The authors state
> that activated-carbon filters had restricted run duration to 5–7 days; the SCR
> DeNOx installation was intended to support longer runs and future emissions
> requirements.
>
> The scale-up slide repeats Tata Steel's 10 December 2025 decision to start
> engineering and regulatory work for an approximately 1 Mt/y Jamshedpur
> demonstration plant. It does not establish FID, construction, commissioning or
> commercial operation.
